title: JayziSniffer  Advanced RemoteEvent Inspector
features:
JayziSniffer is a sleek, interactive UI tool designed for developers and exploiters to monitor, analyze, and interact with RemoteEvents in real time. Built with a clean layout and intuitive controls, it offers full visibility into client-server communication and empowers users with powerful utilities for debugging, reverse engineering, or automation.
Core Features:

    Live RemoteEvent Capture Automatically hooks into all RemoteEvents across the game and logs incoming traffic with full argument visibility.,

    Event History Panel Displays a scrollable list of all captured RemoteEvents. Selecting an event reveals its full argument payload in JSON format.,

    Argument Viewer Clean, multi-line text box that shows the selected event’s arguments. Supports long strings with proper wrapping and scroll.,

Control Buttons:

    Copy: Copies the argument payload to clipboard,

    Execute: Replays the RemoteEvent with the captured arguments,

    Clear: Clears the event history,

    Refresh: Re-scans and reconnects to all RemoteEvents,

    Ban Event: Blocks selected RemoteEvent from being logged,

    Remove all restrictions: Unblocks all previously banned events,

    Copy Players ID/Nick: Opens a player list with copyable usernames and UserIds,

Player Inspector Panel:

Accessible via the Copy Players ID/Nick button, this panel displays:

    Player avatars,

    Username and UserId,

    Buttons to copy either the nickname or ID instantly
